description:
Search, evaluate, and compare 17,000+ MCP servers from the [MCPpedia](https://mcppedia.org) catalog. Every server is scored on **security, maintenance, efficiency, documentation, and compatibility** — with real CVE scanning and tool-poisoning detection.

## Tools

- **search_servers** — keyword / category / min-score search
- **get_server_details** — full profile + optional security report (CVEs, tool poisoning, injection risk, dangerous patterns, dep health)
- **compare_servers** — side-by-side across all five scoring dimensions
- **get_install_config** — ready-to-paste config for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf
- **get_trending** — top-rated / most-starred / newest
- **get_category_tree** — every category with live server counts
- **what_changed** — servers re-scored since a given timestamp

## Resources & prompts

Browsable resources: `mcppedia://trending`, `mcppedia://server/{slug}`, `mcppedia://category/{name}`.
Built-in prompts: `audit-my-mcp-setup`, `find-alternative`, `security-review`.

## Why

Stop guessing which MCP server is safe. Agents can now discover, audit, and swap MCPs with grounded data — not vibes.

Browse the full catalog at [mcppedia.org](https://mcppedia.org).

findings.title: Excessive Permission Surface
findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.

findings.title: DoS Resilience — Missing Rate Limit / Timeout
findings.description: tool performs network or execution operations but declares no rate-limit, timeout, or retry configuration
findings.recommendation: Declare explicit rate-limit, timeout, and retry configuration for all network and execution tools. Implement exponential back-off and surface resource state to the calling agent.

findings.title: DEPENDENCY_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE
findings.description: Tool did not expose metadata.dependencies or repo_url, so supply-chain coverage is limited.
findings.recommendation: Review and remediate the identified issue.
